reason: I already pay for a chatbot and I'm fine with it, and moving anything around is work I don't want. I'd poke at the free plan, but I could also wire up an LLM API and a weekend myself.
objection: I already have a chat tool installed and it works. Another widget on my site, plus a monthly fee, for a lift I can't verify up front isn't worth the hassle when I can build the core of it myself.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the free plan produce a clear, measured lift in sign-ups on my own site in the first weeks, with the actions (booking, forms) working out of the box without any setup from me.
